name: sponsor
author: CVER Inc.
source_note: 原始碼將隨 OSS 化公開
calls: POST <data-api-base>/api/v2/shop/sponsor — the bundle's only fetch; sends { guild_id, amount, currency, redirect_url, client_request_ref }; on an ok JSON response, the response's `url` value is assigned to `location.href` without further validation; a 403 JSON checkout_module_not_activated response restores the button and shows the not-activated label; every other failure restores the button with the generic error and stays put
without: requires `checkout`; RSP enforces this by returning 403 with checkout_module_not_activated, which restores the button and shows the coral's configurable not-activated sentence. Without a valid data-api-base, the bundle performs no request and renders its unconnected message; with no feelreef-compatible sponsor endpoint, submission restores the button and shows its configured generic error instead of navigating.
